queries.title: Orders per region
queries.task: Count the orders placed by customers in each region, largest first.
queries.sql:
SELECT c.Region, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Region
ORDER BY orders DESC, c.Region;

queries.title: Revenue by category
queries.task: Total revenue (quantity x unit price x (1 - discount)) per product category, rounded to 2 decimals.
queries.sql:
SELECT p.Category, ROUND(SUM(o.Quantity * p.UnitPrice * (1 - o.Discount)), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN products p ON p.ProductID = o.ProductID
GROUP BY p.Category
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

queries.title: Top 5 customers
queries.task: The five customers with the highest total revenue.
queries.sql:
SELECT o.CustomerID, ROUND(SUM(o.Quantity * p.UnitPrice * (1 - o.Discount)), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN products p ON p.ProductID = o.ProductID
GROUP BY o.CustomerID
ORDER BY revenue DESC, o.CustomerID
LIMIT 5;

queries.title: Customers with no orders
queries.task: List customers who have never ordered.
queries.sql:
SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Region, c.Segment
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE o.OrderID IS NULL
ORDER BY c.CustomerID;

queries.title: Monthly revenue, 2025
queries.task: Revenue for each month of 2025. strftime is SQLite's date function; other databases use their own.
queries.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) AS month, ROUND(SUM(o.Quantity * p.UnitPrice * (1 - o.Discount)), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN products p ON p.ProductID = o.ProductID
WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

queries.title: Average order value by segment
queries.task: Average revenue per order for each customer segment, rounded to 2 decimals.
queries.sql:
SELECT c.Segment, ROUND(SUM(o.Quantity * p.UnitPrice * (1 - o.Discount)) / COUNT(*), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID
JOIN products p ON p.ProductID = o.ProductID
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

queries.title: Running total by month, 2025
queries.task: Monthly revenue for 2025 with a cumulative running total (a window function; needs SQLite 3.25 or later).
queries.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) AS month, SUM(o.Quantity * p.UnitPrice * (1 - o.Discount)) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN products p ON p.ProductID = o.ProductID
  WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue, ROUND(SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS running_total
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month;

queries.title: Categories above a revenue threshold
queries.task: Categories whose total revenue is more than 21,000.
queries.sql:
SELECT p.Category, ROUND(SUM(o.Quantity * p.UnitPrice * (1 - o.Discount)), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN products p ON p.ProductID = o.ProductID
GROUP BY p.Category
HAVING SUM(o.Quantity * p.UnitPrice * (1 - o.Discount)) > 21000
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
